title: Classical Simulation of Two-Layer Quantum Circuits via Output-Dependent Cubic Structure: source and reproducibility archive
description: Source and reproducibility companion for Daniel Fredriksen's informal methods preprint on output-dependent cubic simulation. Contains the manuscript PDF and source, exact arithmetic implementation, finite checks and provenance. The canonical paper will have a separate PDF-first publication/preprint record. Code is Apache-2.0; manuscript and prose are CC-BY-4.0 as detailed in LICENSE. No Lean certification, peer review, universal simulation or practical superiority is claimed.
